title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Room to fail
hook: When did you last let a drill go wrong on purpose?
intro: You can see the mistake coming.
You could stop the drill and fix it.
statement: Practice is the safest place to fail.
q1: Do you let players struggle and figure it out —
q2: or step in early so practice stays on track?
q3: What do kids learn when no one rescues them?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids learn more
t2: when they get to work through a mistake.
cta: Coaches — do you let them struggle?
ctaLines: Wait one more rep. Ask a question. Step in.
Let it play out or fix it now?
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When did you last let a drill go wrong on purpose?
You can see the mistake coming. You could stop the drill and fix it.
Practice is the safest place to fail.
Let it play out or step in early. There is no single right way.
Do you let them struggle? Share your habit in the comments.
